sentence: Please check that she has the documents she needs before the meeting.
synonym: make sure she has the papers she needs
synonymNote: 两者都表示确认她拥有所需文件，意思相同

distractors.word: ask her to prepare new documents
distractors.note: 这是让她准备新文件，不是确认已有文件

distractors.word: give her the documents she needs
distractors.note: 这是给她文件，而不是确认她是否已有

distractors.word: remind her to read the documents
distractors.note: 这是提醒她阅读文件，不是确认她是否拥有
